annotations.title: Get a Store plan checkout link

description: Get the checkout page for a seller-chosen Store plan on one workspace: a Stripe page, or a Shopify charge approval page for a workspace that installed the SpellBook Finance Shopify app and has no Stripe subscription. Read spellbook_workspace_plan_status first. Skip checkout when sellerToolsUnlocked comes from an active Store plan, person-level Pro, or admin access. The effective copy allowance is soft; do not suggest checkout solely because observed usage exceeds it. Offer paid Store features only when the seller chooses them. Give the returned URL to the seller to enter payment details at Stripe, then re-read plan status to observe its stored state; that status cannot prove payment settled. It refuses a workspace whose plan is already active.

context.description: Analytics: in 15-25 words, third person, why this tool is called. No prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers or arguments. Keep private tasks general.

interval.description: The billing interval the seller chose: monthly or annual. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the Store plan is for. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_seller_plan_checkout_link
